def inside_project(project, target):
    """拒绝通过软链接路由的资料文件。"""
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(project) or not target.is_relative_to(project):
        return False
    for path in (target, *target.parents):
        if path == project:
            break
        if path.is_symlink():
            return False
    return True


def visible(project, target):
    """校验拟落盘文件的真实归属与 Git 可见性。"""
    if not inside_project(project, target):
        return False
    ancestor = next(path for path in target.parents if path.exists())
    return git_root(ancestor) == project and git(project, "check-ignore", "--no-index", "--", str(target)).returncode == 1


def candidate_roots(project):
    """沿项目显式设置、已有 Agent 工具资料和项目内默认目录选址。"""
    config = project / ".codex/conversation-recording.json"
    if config.is_file() and not config.is_symlink():
        custom = json.loads(config.read_bytes()).get("recordRoot")
        if isinstance(custom, str) and custom:
            yield project / custom, "项目记录配置"
    if (project / ".specify/feature.json").is_file() and (project / ".specify/memory").is_dir():
        yield project / ".specify/memory/conversation-recording", "Spec Kit 项目资料"
    yield project, "项目根下的 records 目录"
    yield project / "conversation-recording", "项目内独立资料目录"


def record_prelude(document):
    """取第一轮之前的主记录前言。"""
    first_turn = TURN_HEADER.search(document)
    return document[:first_turn.start()] if first_turn else document


def record_metadata(scope, base, reason):
    """保存选址和可核实的会话来源。"""
    return {"session": scope.session, "project": str(scope.project), "origin": str(scope.origin),
            "root": str(base.relative_to(scope.project)), "reason": reason}


def with_title_candidate(scope, path, document, candidate):
    """在主记录头部保留首个已核对的候选。"""
    prelude = record_prelude(document)
    header = RECORD_HEADER.search(prelude)
    if header:
        metadata = json.loads(header[1])
    else:
        if f"会话 `{scope.session}`" not in prelude:
            return document
        metadata = record_metadata(scope, path.parents[2], "沿用已有主记录")
    if "titleCandidate" in metadata:
        return document
    metadata["titleCandidate"] = candidate
    # 转义可能提前结束 Markdown 注释的字符，保留读回的标题原值。
    encoded = json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False).replace(">", r"\u003e")
    if header:
        return document[:header.start(1)] + encoded + document[header.end(1):]
    return f"<!-- foundry-recording {encoded} -->\n\n{document}"


def find_record(scope):
    """优先复用经来源核实的记录，绕开新命中的 Git 忽略位置。"""
    suffix = Path("records") / scope.opening / f"{scope.session}.md"
    roots = list(candidate_roots(scope.project))
    files = git(scope.project, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard",
                "--", f":(glob)**/{suffix.as_posix()}")
    ignored = git(scope.project, "ls-files", "-z", "--ignored", "--others", "--exclude-standard",
                  "--", f":(glob)**/{suffix.as_posix()}")
    known = {base / suffix for base, _ in roots}
    known.update(scope.project / os.fsdecode(path) for path in (files.stdout + ignored.stdout).split(b"\0") if path)
    existing = []
    superseded = set()
    for path in sorted(known):
        if not inside_project(scope.project, path) or not path.is_file():
            continue
        content = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
        marker = RECORD_HEADER.search(record_prelude(content))
        if not marker:
            # 保留并复用具备相同会话头的旧版记录。
            if f"会话 `{scope.session}`" not in content:
                raise ValueError(f"主记录同名文件归属不明：{path}")
        else:
            saved = json.loads(marker[1])
            if (saved.get("session"), saved.get("project"), saved.get("origin")) != (
                scope.session, str(scope.project), str(scope.origin)
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"主记录会话来源不符：{path}")
            superseded.update(scope.project / item for item in saved.get("previousRecords", []) if isinstance(item, str))
        existing.append((path, content))
    eligible = [(path, content) for path, content in existing if path not in superseded and visible(scope.project, path)]
    if len(eligible) > 1:
        raise ValueError("存在多份可写的同一会话主记录")
    if eligible:
        return eligible[0]
    for base, reason in roots:
        path = base / suffix
        if not path.exists() and visible(scope.project, path):
            details = record_metadata(scope, base, reason)
            if existing:
                details["previousRecords"] = [str(path.relative_to(scope.project)) for path, _ in existing]
                details["restartTurn"] = scope.turn
            heading = (f"# 对话记录\n\n会话 `{scope.session}` · 开启 `{scope.opened_at}` · 目录 `{scope.origin}`\n\n"
                       f"<!-- foundry-recording {json.dumps(details, ensure_ascii=False)} -->\n")
            return path, heading
    raise OSError("找不到 Git 可见的项目内记录位置")


def quoted(label, value):
    """为多行原话添加可逆的 Markdown 外层前缀。"""
    return f"> - **{label}** " + "\n>   ".join(value.split("\n")) + "\n"


def detail_blocks(document):
    """用围栏外的事件定位保持已确认块，按原位置重试不完整块。"""
    starts = []
    fence = None
    offset = 0
    for raw in document.splitlines(keepends=True):
        line = raw.rstrip("\r\n")
        if fence:
            if line == fence:
                fence = None
        elif re.fullmatch(r"~{3,}text", line):
            fence = line.removesuffix("text")
        elif match := DETAIL_EVENT.fullmatch(line):
            starts.append((offset, match[2], match[1] == "event"))
        offset += len(raw)
    blocks = {}
    for (start, key, complete), (end, _, _) in zip(starts, [*starts[1:], (len(document), None, None)]):
        blocks[key] = (complete, document[start:end])
    return (document[:starts[0][0]] if starts else document), blocks


def detail_document(scope, path, events):
    """逐项确认附件与详情，再把可用的链接交给主记录。"""
    target = path.parent / "details" / scope.session / f"{scope.turn}.md"
    if not visible(scope.project, target):
        raise OSError(f"详情路径不在可写的 Git 范围：{target}")
    owner = f"<!-- foundry-detail {scope.session} {scope.turn} -->"
    header = f"# 对话经过\n\n会话 `{scope.session}` · 轮次 `{scope.turn}`\n\n{owner}\n"
    previous = target.read_bytes().decode("utf-8") if target.is_file() else header
    if not previous.startswith(header):
        raise OSError(f"同名详情归属未确认：{target}")
    prelude, blocks = detail_blocks(previous)
    for event in events:
        key = sha256((event.identity or f"{event.location}:{event.label}").encode()).hexdigest()
        if key in blocks and blocks[key][0]:
            continue
        length = max((len(match[0]) for match in re.finditer(r"~+", event.value)), default=0)
        fence = "~" * max(3, length + 1)
        pieces = [f"## {event.label}\n\n- 来源定位：{event.location}\n\n{fence}text\n{event.value}\n{fence}\n"]
        complete = not event.provisional
        for attachment in event.attachments:
            checksum = sha256(attachment.data).hexdigest()
            name = Path(redacted(attachment.name))
            filename = f"{name.stem}-{checksum}{name.suffix}"
            text = attachment.data.decode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape")
            if redacted(text) != text:
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：原件包含需省略的内容。\n")
                continue
            original = target.parent / "attachments" / filename
            if not visible(scope.project, original):
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：原件目标不在 Git 可见范围。\n")
                complete = False
                continue
            if original.is_file() and original.read_bytes() != attachment.data:
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：同一摘要路径已有不同内容。\n")
                complete = False
                continue
            try:
                atomic_write(original, attachment.data)
            except OSError:
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：原件写入或读回失败。\n")
                complete = False
                continue
            pieces.append(f"\n- [附件](attachments/{quote(filename)}) · SHA-256 `{checksum}`\n")
        status = "event" if complete else "pending"
    atomic_write(target, prelude + "".join(block for _, block in blocks.values()))
    return target.relative_to(path.parent).as_posix()


@dataclass
class TurnRecord:
    """定位主记录中的一轮，写回时保留前后的其他轮次。"""

    path: Path
    before: str
    text: str
    after: str
    messages: list[tuple[str, str]]
    legacy: bool = False
    detail: str | None = None

    def append(self, label, value):
        """用长度保护原话边界，标题和横线仅用于展示。"""
        if self.legacy:
            self.text += quoted(label, value)
        else:
            separator = MESSAGE_SEPARATOR if self.messages else "\n"
            self.text += (f"{separator}<!-- foundry-message {label} {len(value)} -->\n"
                          f"\n### {MESSAGE_TITLES[label]}\n\n{value}\n")
        self.messages.append((label, value))

    def save(self, scope, agent_message=None):
        """将当前轮块写回并读回核对。"""
        footer = f"\n[查看经过]({self.detail})\n" if self.detail else ""
        additions = (agent_message,) if agent_message is not None else ()
        return write_timeline(scope, self.path, self.before + self.text + footer + self.after, additions)


def write_timeline(scope, path, document, agent_messages=()):
    """在父会话锁内按事件身份合并子代理消息并保存。"""
    if agent_messages:
        turns, messages, _ = record_sections(document)
        if turns and turns[-1][2][1]:
            document = modernize_last_turn(path, document, turns)
            turns, messages, _ = record_sections(document)
        if not messages or messages[-1].start < turns[-1][0]:
            raise ValueError("主记录缺少可续写子代理消息的轮次")
        known = {message.agent.identity for message in messages if message.agent}
        blocks = []
        for note, value in agent_messages:
            if note.identity not in known:
                blocks.append(MESSAGE_SEPARATOR + agent_block(note, value))
                known.add(note.identity)
        end = messages[-1].end
        document = document[:end] + "".join(blocks) + document[end:]
    if "foundry-agent-message" in document:
        turns, messages, _ = record_sections(document)
        document = order_timeline(scope.transcript, document, turns, messages)
    atomic_write(path, document)
    return document
    text = current[start:end]
    after = current[end:]
    if heading[1]:
        separator = "\n" if text.endswith("\n\n") else ""
        saved = [(label, value.replace("\n>   ", "\n")) for label, value in LEGACY_MESSAGE.findall(text)]
        return TurnRecord(path, current[:start], text.removesuffix(separator), separator + after, saved, legacy=True)

    saved = [(item.label, item.text) for item in messages if start <= item.start < end and item.agent is None]
    footer = next(((position, link) for position, link in links if start <= position < end), None)
    if footer:
        position, detail = footer
        return TurnRecord(path, current[:start], current[start:position], after, saved, detail=detail)
    return TurnRecord(path, current[:start], text, after, saved)


def load_turn(scope, inputs):
    """按宿主确认过的输入补齐缺失消息。"""
    turn = open_turn(scope)
    if not turn.messages:
        if not inputs:
            return None
        turn.append("发起", inputs[0])
    existing = sum(label == "补充" for label, _ in turn.messages)
    for supplemental in inputs[1 + existing:]:
        turn.append("补充", supplemental)
    return turn


def link_details(scope, turn, events):
    """确认详情后补上链接，返回可在主记录保存后报告的写入错误。"""
    if not events:
        return None
    try:
        link = detail_document(scope, turn.path, events)
    except OSError as error:
        return error
    if not turn.legacy:
        turn.detail = link
    elif "\n> - [查看经过](" not in turn.text:
        turn.text += f"> - [查看经过]({link})\n"
    return None


@contextmanager
def session_lock(scope):
    """串行化同一会话的记录更新。"""
    with scope.transcript.open("rb") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        yield


def run_hook(event_name, handle, *, cwd=None):
    """接收指定的 Codex 事件，核验归属并报告记录缺口。"""
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    if data.get("hook_event_name") != event_name:
        return
    # 共享模块安装在 <项目根>/.agents/skills/conversation-recording/recording/。
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
    try:
        scope = verify_scope(project, data, Path(data["cwd"]) if cwd is None else cwd,
                             allow_idle=event_name == "SubagentStop")
        if scope is not None:
            handle(scope, data)
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, OSError, sqlite3.Error) as error:
        # 记录故障保留为提示，业务轮次继续。
        message = redacted(f"会话记录出现缺口 · {data.get('turn_id')} · {data.get('hook_event_name')}：{error}")

"""Codex 的 Stop 命令入口，保存并读回正常发出的最终回复。"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from recording.events import collect, redacted
from recording.record import link_details, load_turn, run_hook, session_lock
from recording.subagents import recover_subagent_messages


def record_reply(scope, data):
    """从 Stop 回调保存实发回复，收尾时补齐宿主可提供的详情。"""
    reply = data.get("last_assistant_message")
    with session_lock(scope):
        contents = collect(scope)
        if contents.commit_result:
            return
        turn = load_turn(scope, contents.inputs)
        if turn is None:
            return

        failure = link_details(scope, turn, contents.events)
        if isinstance(reply, str) and reply and not any(label == "回复" for label, _ in turn.messages):
            turn.append("回复", redacted(reply))
        document = turn.save(scope)
        if failure is not None:
            raise failure
        if not contents.pending_code_calls:
            recover_subagent_messages(scope, turn.path, document,
                                      current_activity=any(event.label == "子代理活动" for event in contents.events))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_hook("Stop", record_reply)
"""Codex 的 UserPromptSubmit 命令入口，负责保存并读回用户消息。"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from recording.events import collect, redacted
from recording.record import open_turn, run_hook, session_lock
from recording.subagents import recover_subagent_messages


def record_prompt(scope, data):
    """在业务开始前保存并读回用户发起的消息或同轮补充。"""
    prompt = data.get("prompt")
    if not isinstance(prompt, str):
        return
    prompt = redacted(prompt)

    with session_lock(scope):
        turn = open_turn(scope)
        if not turn.messages:
            turn.append("发起", prompt)
            document = turn.save(scope)
            recover_subagent_messages(scope, turn.path, document)
            return

        count = sum(label in {"发起", "补充"} for label, _ in turn.messages)
        repeated = turn.messages[-1] in (("发起", prompt), ("补充", prompt))
        # 用宿主输入条数区分重复回调和真实的同文补充。
        if not repeated or len(collect(scope).inputs) >= count:
            turn.append("补充", prompt)
            turn.save(scope)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_hook("UserPromptSubmit", record_prompt)

~~~

specs/skills/002-conversation-to-skill/mvu.md:33:同日从本仓库同时打开的会话各写各的文档。用户关闭、终止或中断会话后，项目记录已启用且原会话和恢复后的有效工作目录均可核实属于本仓库时，沿合规的原资料根和原日期从断点续写。若旧资料位置命中 Git 忽略规则，从新选的项目位置记录当前及后续内容，旧文件留在原位。来源不符或无法核实的恢复跳过写入和正文补读，既有记录仍可回查。写入前关闭且原文丢失的内容保留为缺档。

MESSAGE_HEADER = re.compile(r"^<!-- foundry-message (发起|补充|回复) (\d{1,20}) -->\n", re.M)
AGENT_MESSAGE_HEADER = re.compile(r"^<!-- foundry-agent-message ([A-Za-z0-9_=-]+) (\d{1,20}) -->\n", re.M)
DETAIL_LINK = re.compile(r"^\[查看经过\]\((details/[^)\n]+)\)\n", re.M)

OPENING = re.compile(r"^rollout-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})T[\d-]+-([\da-f-]{36})\.jsonl$")


def git(path, *arguments):
    """读取实际工作树，避免外部 Git 变量替换选址上下文。"""
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("GIT_")}
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(path), *arguments], capture_output=True, env=env)


def git_root(path):
    result = git(path, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
    return Path(os.fsdecode(result.stdout.rstrip(b"\n"))).resolve() if result.returncode == 0 else None


def atomic_write(path, text):
    """在同目录原子替换文件，重开文件确认原始字节。"""
    content = text if isinstance(text, bytes) else text.encode("utf-8")
    if path.is_symlink() or (path.exists() and not path.is_file()):
        raise OSError(f"写入路径冲突：{path}")
    if path.is_file() and path.read_bytes() == content:
        return None
    verified = False
    while True:
        key = header_string(stream)
        if key not in ("type", "timestamp", "ordinal", "payload") or header_byte(stream) != b":":
            return None
        if key == "payload":
            if not verified or header_byte(stream) != b"{" or header_string(stream) != "type":
                return None
            if header_byte(stream) != b":" or header_string(stream) != inner:
                return None
            break
        if key == "type":
            if header_string(stream) != outer:
                return None
            if inner is None:
                break
            verified = True
        elif key == "timestamp":
            if header_string(stream) is None:
                return None
        else:
            value = header_byte(stream)
            if value not in b"0123456789" or not value:
                return None
            for _ in range(24):
                value = stream.read(1)
                if not value or value not in b"0123456789":
                    stream.seek(-1, os.SEEK_CUR)
                    break
        if header_byte(stream) != b",":
            return None
    stream.seek(offset)
    line = stream.readline(65536)
    return json.loads(line) if line.endswith(b"\n") else None


@dataclass(frozen=True)

def transcript_location(path, session):
    """核对宿主日志位置和文件名中的真实会话身份。"""
    state = Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_HOME") or Path.home() / ".codex").resolve()
    transcript = Path(path).resolve()
    opening = OPENING.fullmatch(transcript.name)
    if not opening or opening[2] != session or not transcript.is_relative_to(state / "sessions"):
        return None
    if not transcript.is_file():
        return None
    return transcript, opening[1]


def index_path(name):
    """定位宿主分页索引或会话路径索引。"""
    state = Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_HOME") or Path.home() / ".codex").resolve()
    return Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_SQLITE_HOME") or state).resolve() / name

        """终止本探针 PID 命名空间内的原生宿主，保留未完成回调边界。"""
        metadata = json.loads((state / "app-server-daemon/daemon.pid").read_text())
        process = metadata["pid"]
        descriptor = os.pidfd_open(process)
        try:
            argv = (Path("/proc") / str(process) / "cmdline").read_bytes().split(b"\0")
            assert b"app-server" in argv and Path(os.fsdecode(argv[0])).name == "codex", argv
            signal.pidfd_send_signal(descriptor, signal.SIGKILL)

    def title_candidate(self):
        prefix = "<!-- foundry-recording "
        header = next(line for line in self.record.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith(prefix))
        return json.loads(header.removeprefix(prefix).removesuffix(" -->")).get("titleCandidate")

    def test_title_candidate_has_verified_origin_and_is_saved_once(self):
        self.install()
        self.seed_turn()
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="排查会话记录")
        child = str(uuid4())
        self.launch_child("name-task", child, "宿主提供的派发正文", "2026-11-26T12:00:01Z", task_name="recording_title")
        self.callback("Stop", last_assistant_message="主回复已经发送")
        self.parent_status("completed")
        at = "2026-11-26T12:00:03Z"
        reply = self.child_reply(child, self.turn, '{"title":"排查会话记录"}', at, agent_path="/root/recording_title")
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.title_candidate(), {
            "title": "排查会话记录", "parentTurn": self.turn, "dispatchCall": "name-task",
            "childThread": child, "childTurn": reply["turn_id"], "repliedAt": at,
        })
        saved = self.record.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.record.read_bytes(), saved)
        self.next_parent_turn("2026-11-26T12:00:04Z")
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="继续核对")
        newer = str(uuid4())
        self.launch_child("later-name", newer, "再次尝试命名", "2026-11-26T12:00:05Z", task_name="recording_title")
        self.parent_status("completed")
        new_reply = self.child_reply(newer, self.turn, '{"title":"另一标题"}', "2026-11-26T12:00:06Z",
                                     agent_path="/root/recording_title")
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **new_reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.title_candidate()["title"], "排查会话记录")

    @staticmethod
    def tool_call(ordinal, call, arguments):
        return {"ordinal": ordinal, "type": "response_item", "payload": {"type": "function_call",
                "name": "exec_command", "call_id": call, "arguments": json.dumps(arguments)}}

    @staticmethod
    def tool_output(ordinal, call, output):
        return {"ordinal": ordinal, "type": "response_item", "payload": {"type": "function_call_output",
                "call_id": call, "output": output}}

    def native_command(self, call, script, output, exit_code=0):
        return {"type": "event_msg", "payload": {"type": "item_completed", "turn_id": self.turn,
                "item": {"type": "CommandExecution", "id": call, "command": ["[已省略环境变量值]", "-lc", script],
                         "cwd": self.repo.as_uri(), "aggregated_output": output, "exit_code": exit_code}}}

    @staticmethod
    def code_call(call, code):
        return {"type": "response_item", "payload": {"type": "custom_tool_call", "name": "exec",
                "call_id": call, "input": code}}

        self.callback("PostToolUse", tool_name="Bash", tool_use_id="during", tool_input=arguments,
                      tool_response="回调先收到文本")
        detail = self.record.parent / f"details/{self.session}/{self.turn}.md"
        self.assertIn("回调先收到文本", detail.read_text())

        original = b"attachment from the host"
        output = self.tool_output(3, "during", [{"type": "image", "name": "report.png",
                                  "mimeType": "image/png", "data": b64encode(original).decode()}])
        self.seed_turn(events=[call, output])
        self.callback("Stop", last_assistant_message="完成")
        self.assertEqual({path.read_bytes() for path in detail.parent.glob("attachments/*")}, {original})
        self.assertEqual(detail.read_text().count("## 工具结果 `during`"), 1)

    def test_unowned_detail_and_same_turn_supplement(self):
        self.install()
        self.seed_turn(events=[self.tool_call(2, "read", {"cmd": "cat README.md"})])
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="读一下")
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="同时检查文件末尾")
        self.assertIn("### 用户 · 补充\n\n同时检查文件末尾", self.record.read_text())
        detail = self.record.parent / f"details/{self.session}/{self.turn}.md"
        detail.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        detail.write_text("既有未受管详情\n")
        self.callback("Stop", last_assistant_message="已读")
        self.assertEqual(detail.read_text(), "既有未受管详情\n")
        self.assertIn("已读", self.record.read_text())

    def test_later_callback_recovers_prompt_only_from_actual_host_input(self):
        self.install()
        input_event = {"ordinal": 3, "type": "response_item", "payload": {"type": "message", "role": "user",
                       "content": [{"type": "input_text", "text": "可取得的真实输入"}],
                       "internal_chat_message_metadata_passthrough": {"content_item_kinds": ["user.text"]}}}
        self.seed_turn(events=[input_event])
        exclusions = self.repo / ".gitignore"
        exclusions.write_text("/records/\n/conversation-recording/\n")
        self.assertIn("缺口", self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="可取得的真实输入")["systemMessage"])
        self.assertFalse(self.record.exists())
        exclusions.unlink()
        self.callback("Stop", last_assistant_message="正常回复")
        self.assertIn("可取得的真实输入", self.record.read_text())
        self.assertIn("正常回复", self.record.read_text())

    def test_environment_values_and_auth_file_contents_are_omitted(self):
        self.install()
        value = "T035_TEST_PRIVATE_VALUE"
        self.env["T035_TEST_TOKEN"] = value
        self.env["T035_SHORT_TOKEN"] = "a1b2c3"
        self.env["DATABASE_URL"] = "[已省略凭据]example.invalid/database"
        events = [self.tool_call(2, "auth", {"cmd": "cat .codex/auth.json"}),
                  self.tool_output(3, "auth", "T035_FIXTURE_AUTH_FILE_CONTENT")]
        self.seed_turn(events=events)
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt=f"环境值 {value} a1b2c3 {self.env['DATABASE_URL']}")
        self.callback("Stop", last_assistant_message=f"答复 {value}")
        self.assertNotIn(value, self.record.read_text())
        self.assertNotIn("a1b2c3", self.record.read_text())
        self.assertNotIn("fixture-pass", self.record.read_text())
        self.assertIn("已省略", self.record.read_text())
        detail = self.record.parent / f"details/{self.session}/{self.turn}.md"
        self.assertNotIn("T035_FIXTURE_AUTH_FILE_CONTENT", detail.read_text())


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

def save_subagent_updates(scope, path, document, *, tool_messages=(), replies=()):
    """在已有写入锁内一起保存标题候选和对应的子代理消息。"""
    candidates = [reply for reply in replies if reply.title_candidate]
    if candidates:
        first = min(candidates, key=lambda reply: (event_time(reply.note.at), reply.note.identity))
        document = with_title_candidate(scope, path, document, first.title_candidate)
    messages = list(tool_messages)
    messages.extend((reply.note, reply.text) for reply in replies)
    write_timeline(scope, path, document, messages)


def recover_subagent_messages(scope, path, document, *, current_activity=False):
    """在安全的父回调补齐可证事件，跳过已保存的宿主身份。"""
    if not current_activity and "foundry-agent-message" not in document:
        return
    _, messages, _ = record_sections(document)
    recorded = [message.agent for message in messages if message.agent]
    known = {note.identity for note in recorded}
    children = {note.child for note in recorded if note.kind == "派发"}
    calls = {}
    for call in activities(scope):
        calls.setdefault(call.child, []).append(call)
    additions = []
    replies = []
    for child, entries in calls.items():
        dispatch = next((entry for entry in entries if entry.kind == "派发"), None)
        if not dispatch:
            continue
        if dispatch.naming_path:
            children.add(child)
        for entry in entries:
            if entry.turn == scope.turn and entry.message is not None:
                note, value = tool_message(entry, dispatch, entry.message)
                if note.identity not in known:
                    additions.append((note, value))
                children.add(child)

    if index_path("state_5.sqlite").is_file():
        with thread_index("state_5.sqlite") as state, thread_index() as history:
            for child in children & calls.keys():
                entries = calls[child]
                dispatch = next((entry for entry in entries if entry.kind == "派发"), None)
                if dispatch is None:
                    continue
                pending = [(turn, offset) for turn, offset in history.execute(
                    "SELECT turn_id, rollout_byte_offset FROM thread_turns WHERE thread_id = ?", (child,)
                ) if f"reply:{child}:{turn}" not in known and isinstance(offset, int) and offset >= 0]
                if not pending:
                    continue
                location = state.execute("SELECT rollout_path FROM threads WHERE id = ?", (child,)).fetchone()
                if not location or not location[0]:
                    continue
                transcript = verified_child(scope, child, location[0], agent_path=dispatch.naming_path)
                if transcript is None:
                    continue
                replies.extend(message for turn, offset in pending
                               if (message := indexed_reply(transcript, offset, turn, dispatch, entries)) is not None)
    if additions or replies:
        save_subagent_updates(scope, path, document, tool_messages=additions, replies=replies)


class SubagentStopHook:
    """处理业务子代理完成回复后的项目记录回调。"""

    def record_reply(self, scope, data):
        """在父轮空闲时保存，活跃父轮交由父会话回调补齐。"""
        deadline = None
        while True:
            with session_lock(scope):
                scope = verify_scope(scope.project, data, scope.cwd, allow_idle=True)
                if scope is None or not parent_directory_matches(scope):
                    return
                if not scope.active:
                    # 下一次主代理业务动作仍须通过同一把锁保存用户输入。
                    self._save_idle_reply(scope, data)
                    return
                if not any(label == "回复" for label, _ in open_turn(scope).messages):
                    return
            # Stop 已保存父回复，宿主可能尚未完成索引更新。复查期间释放写入锁。
            if deadline is None:
                deadline = monotonic() + 0.5
            remaining = deadline - monotonic()
            if remaining <= 0:
                return
            sleep(min(0.025, remaining))

    @staticmethod
    def _save_idle_reply(scope, data):
        """核对子回调的实发回复，并写入已存在的父会话记录。"""
        if collect(scope).pending_code_calls:
            return
        child = str(UUID(data["agent_id"]))
        child_turn = str(UUID(data["turn_id"]))
        reply = data.get("last_assistant_message")
        if not isinstance(reply, str) or not reply:
            return
        calls = [call for call in activities(scope) if call.child == child]
        dispatch = next((call for call in calls if call.kind == "派发"), None)
        if dispatch is None:
            return
        transcript = verified_child(scope, child, data["agent_transcript_path"],
                                    agent_path=dispatch.naming_path)
        if transcript is None:
            return
        offset = child_turn_offset(child, child_turn)
        message = indexed_reply(transcript, offset, child_turn, dispatch, calls, reply=reply)
        if message is None:
            return
        path, document = find_record(scope)
        if path.is_file():
            save_subagent_updates(scope, path, document, replies=(message,))
"""Codex 的 Stop 命令入口，保存并读回正常发出的最终回复。"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from recording.events import collect, redacted
from recording.record import link_details, load_turn, run_hook, session_lock
from recording.subagents import recover_subagent_messages


def record_reply(scope, data):
    """从 Stop 回调保存实发回复，收尾时补齐宿主可提供的详情。"""
    reply = data.get("last_assistant_message")
    with session_lock(scope):
        contents = collect(scope)
        if contents.commit_result:
            return
        turn = load_turn(scope, contents.inputs)
        if turn is None:
            return

        failure = link_details(scope, turn, contents.events)
        if isinstance(reply, str) and reply and not any(label == "回复" for label, _ in turn.messages):
            turn.append("回复", redacted(reply))
        document = turn.save(scope)
        if failure is not None:
            raise failure
        if not contents.pending_code_calls:
            recover_subagent_messages(scope, turn.path, document,
                                      current_activity=any(event.label == "子代理活动" for event in contents.events))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_hook("Stop", record_reply)
"""Codex 的 UserPromptSubmit 命令入口，负责保存并读回用户消息。"""

from pathlib import Path
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))

from recording.events import collect, redacted
from recording.record import open_turn, run_hook, session_lock
from recording.subagents import recover_subagent_messages


def record_prompt(scope, data):
    """在业务开始前保存并读回用户发起的消息或同轮补充。"""
    prompt = data.get("prompt")
    if not isinstance(prompt, str):
        return
    prompt = redacted(prompt)

    with session_lock(scope):
        turn = open_turn(scope)
        if not turn.messages:
            turn.append("发起", prompt)
            document = turn.save(scope)
            recover_subagent_messages(scope, turn.path, document)
            return

        count = sum(label in {"发起", "补充"} for label, _ in turn.messages)
        repeated = turn.messages[-1] in (("发起", prompt), ("补充", prompt))
        # 用宿主输入条数区分重复回调和真实的同文补充。
        if not repeated or len(collect(scope).inputs) >= count:
            turn.append("补充", prompt)
            turn.save(scope)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    run_hook("UserPromptSubmit", record_prompt)

"""验证主线记录安装、宿主范围判定及项目内首末轮落盘。"""

from base64 import b64encode
from contextlib import closing
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from uuid import uuid4


SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/profile/conversation-recording"


class ConversationRecordingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="foundry-recording-test-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.repo = self.root / "repo"
        self.repo.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(self.repo)], check=True)
        self.hooks = self.repo / ".codex/hooks.json"
        self.hooks.parent.mkdir()
        self.other_hook = {"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "other-project-hook"}]}
        self.hooks.write_text(json.dumps({"hooks": {"Stop": [self.other_hook]}}))
        self.state = self.root / "state"
        self.turn, self.session = str(uuid4()), str(uuid4())
        self.transcript = self.state / f"sessions/2026/11/25/rollout-2026-11-25T20-00-00-{self.session}.jsonl"
        self.transcript.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.env = {**os.environ, "CODEX_HOME": str(self.state), "CODEX_SQLITE_HOME": str(self.state)}
        self.record = self.repo / f"records/2026-11-25/{self.session}.md"

    def install(self, check=True):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(SOURCE / "install.py"), "--project", str(self.repo)],
                              text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=self.env)

    def seed_turn(self, trigger="user", events=(), origin=None):
        header = {"type": "session_meta", "payload": {"id": self.session, "cwd": str(origin or self.repo),
                  "timestamp": "2026-11-25T12:00:00Z", "originator": "codex-tui", "source": "vscode"}}
        started = {"type": "event_msg", "ordinal": 1, "timestamp": "2026-11-26T12:00:00Z", "payload": {
            "type": "task_started", "turn_id": self.turn, "turn_attribution": {"turn_trigger": trigger}}}
        first = (json.dumps(header) + "\n").encode()
        self.transcript.write_bytes(first + "".join(json.dumps(event) + "\n" for event in [started, *events]).encode())
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "thread_history_1.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS thread_turns (thread_id, turn_id, status, rollout_byte_offset)")
            index.execute("DELETE FROM thread_turns")
            index.execute("INSERT INTO thread_turns VALUES (?, ?, 'inProgress', ?)", (self.session, self.turn, len(first)))

    def callback(self, event, **values):
        hooks = json.loads(self.hooks.read_text())["hooks"]
        self.assertIn(event, hooks, f"安装应登记 {event}")
        groups = hooks[event]
        cmd = groups[-1]["hooks"][0]["command"]
        data = {"hook_event_name": event, "session_id": self.session, "turn_id": self.turn,
                "cwd": str(self.repo), "transcript_path": str(self.transcript), **values}
        result = subprocess.run(["bash", "-c", cmd], input=json.dumps(data), cwd=self.repo, env=self.env,
                                text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return json.loads(result.stdout or "{}")

    def test_installer_preserves_other_hooks_and_is_idempotent(self):
        installed = self.install(check=False)
        self.assertEqual(installed.returncode, 0, installed.stderr)
        initial = self.hooks.read_bytes()
        hooks = json.loads(initial)["hooks"]
        self.assertEqual(hooks["Stop"][0], self.other_hook)
        self.assertEqual(len(hooks["UserPromptSubmit"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(hooks["Stop"]), 2)
        skill = self.repo / ".agents/skills/conversation-recording"
        self.assertTrue((skill / "SKILL.md").is_file())
        self.assertEqual({file.name for file in (skill / "scripts").iterdir()},
                         {"user_prompt_submit.py", "post_tool_use.py", "stop.py", "subagent_stop.py"})
        for event, script in (("UserPromptSubmit", "user_prompt_submit.py"),
                              ("PostToolUse", "post_tool_use.py"), ("Stop", "stop.py"),
                              ("SubagentStop", "subagent_stop.py")):
            command = shlex.split(hooks[event][-1]["hooks"][0]["command"])
            self.assertEqual(Path(command[3]), skill / "scripts" / script)
            self.assertTrue(Path(command[3]).is_file())
        self.install()
        self.assertEqual(self.hooks.read_bytes(), initial)

    def append_host_events(self, transcript, *events):
        with transcript.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            for event in events:
                output.write(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def parent_status(self, status):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "thread_history_1.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("UPDATE thread_turns SET status = ? WHERE thread_id = ? AND turn_id = ?",
                          (status, self.session, self.turn))

    def next_parent_turn(self, timestamp):
        self.parent_status("completed")
        self.turn = str(uuid4())
        offset = self.transcript.stat().st_size
        self.append_host_events(self.transcript, {
            "type": "event_msg", "timestamp": timestamp, "payload": {
                "type": "task_started", "turn_id": self.turn, "turn_attribution": {"turn_trigger": "user"}}},
            {"type": "turn_context", "payload": {"turn_id": self.turn, "cwd": str(self.repo)}})
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "thread_history_1.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("INSERT INTO thread_turns VALUES (?, ?, 'inProgress', ?)",
                          (self.session, self.turn, offset))

    @staticmethod
    def final_answer(timestamp, text):
        return {"type": "response_item", "timestamp": timestamp, "payload": {
            "type": "message", "role": "assistant", "phase": "final_answer",
            "content": [{"type": "output_text", "text": text}]}}

    def launch_child(self, call, child, prompt, timestamp, *, v2=True, followup=False, directory=None, task_name=None):
        kind = "interacted" if followup else "started"
        name = ("collaborationfollowup_task" if followup else "collaborationspawn_agent") if v2 else "spawn_agent"
        arguments = {"message": prompt}
        native = []
        if v2 and task_name:
            arguments["task_name"] = task_name
            native.append({"type": "response_item", "timestamp": timestamp, "payload": {
                "type": "function_call", "namespace": "collaboration", "name": "followup_task" if followup else "spawn_agent",
                "call_id": call, "arguments": json.dumps(arguments)}})
        activity = (
            {"type": "SubAgentActivity", "id": call, "kind": kind, "agent_thread_id": child,
             "agent_path": f"/root/{task_name or '核对'}"}
            if v2 else
            {"type": "CollabAgentToolCall", "id": call, "tool": name, "status": "completed",
             "receiver_thread_ids": [child], "receiver_agents": [{"thread_id": child, "agent_nickname": "核对"}],
             "prompt": prompt}
        )
        self.append_host_events(self.transcript, {
            "type": "turn_context", "payload": {"turn_id": self.turn, "cwd": str(directory or self.repo)}}, *native, {
            "type": "event_msg", "timestamp": timestamp,
            "payload": {"type": "item_completed", "turn_id": self.turn, "item": activity}})
        if directory is None:
            self.callback("PostToolUse", tool_name=name, tool_use_id=call, tool_input=arguments)

    def child_reply(self, child, parent_turn, reply, timestamp, *, parent=None, agent_path="/root/核对"):
        target = self.transcript.with_name(f"rollout-2026-11-25T20-01-00-{child}.jsonl")
        if not target.exists():
            self.append_host_events(target, {"type": "session_meta", "payload": {
                "id": child, "cwd": str(self.repo), "originator": "codex-tui",
                "source": {"subagent": {"thread_spawn": {
                    "parent_thread_id": parent or self.session, "agent_path": agent_path}}}}})
        child_turn = str(uuid4())
        offset = target.stat().st_size
        self.append_host_events(target, {"type": "event_msg", "timestamp": timestamp, "payload": {
            "type": "task_started", "turn_id": child_turn, "turn_attribution": {"parent_turn_id": parent_turn}}},
            {"type": "event_msg", "timestamp": timestamp, "payload": {
                "type": "item_completed", "turn_id": child_turn, "item": {
                    "type": "AgentMessage", "phase": "final_answer", "content": [{"type": "Text", "text": reply}]}}},
            self.final_answer(timestamp, reply))
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "thread_history_1.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("INSERT INTO thread_turns VALUES (?, ?, 'inProgress', ?)", (child, child_turn, offset))
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "state_5.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS threads (id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, rollout_path TEXT)")
            index.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO threads VALUES (?, ?)", (child, str(target)))
        return {"agent_id": child, "turn_id": child_turn, "agent_transcript_path": str(target),
                "last_assistant_message": reply}

    def title_candidate(self):
        prefix = "<!-- foundry-recording "
        header = next(line for line in self.record.read_text().splitlines() if line.startswith(prefix))
        return json.loads(header.removeprefix(prefix).removesuffix(" -->")).get("titleCandidate")

    def test_title_candidate_has_verified_origin_and_is_saved_once(self):
        self.install()
        self.seed_turn()
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="排查会话记录")
        child = str(uuid4())
        self.launch_child("name-task", child, "宿主提供的派发正文", "2026-11-26T12:00:01Z", task_name="recording_title")
        self.callback("Stop", last_assistant_message="主回复已经发送")
        self.parent_status("completed")
        at = "2026-11-26T12:00:03Z"
        reply = self.child_reply(child, self.turn, '{"title":"排查会话记录"}', at, agent_path="/root/recording_title")
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.title_candidate(), {
            "title": "排查会话记录", "parentTurn": self.turn, "dispatchCall": "name-task",
            "childThread": child, "childTurn": reply["turn_id"], "repliedAt": at,
        })
        saved = self.record.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.record.read_bytes(), saved)
        self.next_parent_turn("2026-11-26T12:00:04Z")
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="继续核对")
        newer = str(uuid4())
        self.launch_child("later-name", newer, "再次尝试命名", "2026-11-26T12:00:05Z", task_name="recording_title")
        self.parent_status("completed")
        new_reply = self.child_reply(newer, self.turn, '{"title":"另一标题"}', "2026-11-26T12:00:06Z",
                                     agent_path="/root/recording_title")
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **new_reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.title_candidate()["title"], "排查会话记录")

    def test_title_candidate_empty_result_can_be_followed_by_a_valid_attempt(self):
        self.install()
        self.seed_turn()
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="帮我看看")
        empty_child = str(uuid4())

"""供各 Codex Hook 共用的会话核验和记录写入。"""

from contextlib import closing, contextmanager
from dataclasses import dataclass
from datetime import datetime
import fcntl
from hashlib import sha256
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import sqlite3
import stat
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from urllib.parse import quote
from uuid import UUID

from .events import redacted
from .timeline import MessageSpan, SEPARATOR as MESSAGE_SEPARATOR, agent_block, decode_agent, order_timeline


TURN_HEADER = re.compile(r"^(?:(> \*\*)|## )(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})(?(1)\*\*) <!-- turn-([\da-f-]{36}) -->\n", re.M)
MESSAGE_HEADER = re.compile(r"^<!-- foundry-message (发起|补充|回复) (\d{1,20}) -->\n", re.M)
AGENT_MESSAGE_HEADER = re.compile(r"^<!-- foundry-agent-message ([A-Za-z0-9_=-]+) (\d{1,20}) -->\n", re.M)
DETAIL_LINK = re.compile(r"^\[查看经过\]\((details/[^)\n]+)\)\n", re.M)
RECORD_SECTION = re.compile("|".join(f"(?:{rule.pattern})" for rule in (
    TURN_HEADER, MESSAGE_HEADER, AGENT_MESSAGE_HEADER, DETAIL_LINK)), re.M)
LEGACY_MESSAGE = re.compile(r"^> - \*\*(发起|补充|回复)\*\* (.*(?:\n>   .*)*)$", re.M)
LEGACY_DETAIL = re.compile(r"^> - \[查看经过\]\((details/[^)\n]+)\)\n", re.M)
MESSAGE_TITLES = {"发起": "用户 · 发起", "补充": "用户 · 补充", "回复": "主代理 · 回复"}
RECORD_HEADER = re.compile(r"^<!-- foundry-recording (.+) -->$", re.M)
DETAIL_EVENT = re.compile(r"^<!-- foundry-(event|pending) ([\da-f]{64}) -->$")
OPENING = re.compile(r"^rollout-(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2})T[\d-]+-([\da-f-]{36})\.jsonl$")


def git(path, *arguments):
    """读取实际工作树，避免外部 Git 变量替换选址上下文。"""
    env = {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith("GIT_")}
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(path), *arguments], capture_output=True, env=env)


def git_root(path):
    result = git(path, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
    return Path(os.fsdecode(result.stdout.rstrip(b"\n"))).resolve() if result.returncode == 0 else None


def atomic_write(path, text):
    """在同目录原子替换文件，重开文件确认原始字节。"""
    content = text if isinstance(text, bytes) else text.encode("utf-8")
    if path.is_symlink() or (path.exists() and not path.is_file()):
        raise OSError(f"写入路径冲突：{path}")
    if path.is_file() and path.read_bytes() == content:
        return
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    fd, temporary = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".recording-", dir=path.parent)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, "wb") as stream:
            if path.is_file():
                os.fchmod(stream.fileno(), stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode))
            stream.write(content)
            stream.flush()
            os.fsync(stream.fileno())
        os.replace(temporary, path)
    finally:
        Path(temporary).unlink(missing_ok=True)
    if path.read_bytes() != content:
        raise OSError(f"写入后读回不一致：{path}")


def header_byte(stream):
class Scope:
    project: Path
    transcript: Path
    session: str
    turn: str
    opening: str
    origin: Path
    opened_at: str
    date: str
    offset: int
    cwd: Path
    active: bool


def transcript_location(path, session):
    """核对宿主日志位置和文件名中的真实会话身份。"""
    state = Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_HOME") or Path.home() / ".codex").resolve()
    transcript = Path(path).resolve()
    opening = OPENING.fullmatch(transcript.name)
    if not opening or opening[2] != session or not transcript.is_relative_to(state / "sessions"):
        return None
    if not transcript.is_file():
        return None
    return transcript, opening[1]


def index_path(name):
    """定位宿主分页索引或会话路径索引。"""
    state = Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_HOME") or Path.home() / ".codex").resolve()
    return Path(os.environ.get("CODEX_SQLITE_HOME") or state).resolve() / name


def thread_index(name="thread_history_1.sqlite"):
    """以只读方式访问宿主自身的索引。"""
    return closing(sqlite3.connect(f"{index_path(name).as_uri()}?mode=ro", uri=True))


def verify_scope(project, data, cwd, *, allow_idle=False):
    """在读取会话正文前核对分页索引及项目范围。"""
    session = str(UUID(data["session_id"]))
    turn = None if allow_idle else str(UUID(data["turn_id"]))
    cwd = cwd.resolve()
    if not cwd.is_relative_to(project) or git_root(cwd) != project:
        return None
    location = transcript_location(data["transcript_path"], session)
    if location is None:
        return None
    transcript, opening = location
    if not index_path("thread_history_1.sqlite").is_file():
        return None
    with thread_index() as connection:
        recent = connection.execute(
            "SELECT turn_id, status, rollout_byte_offset FROM thread_turns WHERE thread_id = ? "
            "ORDER BY rollout_byte_offset DESC LIMIT 2",
            (session,),
        ).fetchall()
    if not recent:
        return None
    # 宿主强制中断后，旧轮次可能继续标为 inProgress。
    indexed_turn, status, offset = recent[0]
    if allow_idle:
        turn = str(UUID(indexed_turn))
    if indexed_turn != turn or status not in (("inProgress", "completed") if allow_idle else ("inProgress",)):
        return None
    if not isinstance(offset, int) or offset < 0:
        return None
    if len(recent) == 2 and recent[1][2] == offset:
        return None
    with transcript.open("rb", buffering=0) as stream:
        current = event_header(stream, offset, "event_msg", "task_started")
        if not current:
            return None
        start = current.get("payload", {})
        if start.get("turn_id") != turn or (start.get("turn_attribution") or {}).get("turn_trigger") != "user":
            return None
        meta = event_header(stream, 0, "session_meta")
    original = (meta or {}).get("payload", {})
    if original.get("id") != session or original.get("originator") != "codex-tui" or not original.get("cwd"):
        return None
    if isinstance(original.get("source"), dict) and "subagent" in original["source"]:
        return None
    origin = Path(original["cwd"]).resolve()
    if not origin.is_relative_to(project) or git_root(origin) != project:
        return None
    date = datetime.fromisoformat(current["timestamp"].replace("Z", "+00:00")).astimezone().date().isoformat()
    return Scope(project, transcript, session, turn, opening, origin, original["timestamp"], date, offset, cwd,
                 status == "inProgress")


def inside_project(project, target):
    """拒绝通过软链接路由的资料文件。"""
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(project) or not target.is_relative_to(project):
        return False
    for path in (target, *target.parents):
        if path == project:
            break
        if path.is_symlink():
            return False
    return True


def visible(project, target):
    """校验拟落盘文件的真实归属与 Git 可见性。"""
    if not inside_project(project, target):
        return False
    ancestor = next(path for path in target.parents if path.exists())
    return git_root(ancestor) == project and git(project, "check-ignore", "--no-index", "--", str(target)).returncode == 1


def candidate_roots(project):
    """沿项目显式设置、已有 Agent 工具资料和项目内默认目录选址。"""
    config = project / ".codex/conversation-recording.json"
    if config.is_file() and not config.is_symlink():
        custom = json.loads(config.read_bytes()).get("recordRoot")
        if isinstance(custom, str) and custom:
            yield project / custom, "项目记录配置"
    if (project / ".specify/feature.json").is_file() and (project / ".specify/memory").is_dir():
        yield project / ".specify/memory/conversation-recording", "Spec Kit 项目资料"
    yield project, "项目根下的 records 目录"
    yield project / "conversation-recording", "项目内独立资料目录"


def record_prelude(document):
    """取第一轮之前的主记录前言。"""
    first_turn = TURN_HEADER.search(document)
    return document[:first_turn.start()] if first_turn else document


def record_metadata(scope, base, reason):
    """保存选址和可核实的会话来源。"""
    return {"session": scope.session, "project": str(scope.project), "origin": str(scope.origin),
            "root": str(base.relative_to(scope.project)), "reason": reason}


def with_title_candidate(scope, path, document, candidate):
    """在主记录头部保留首个已核对的候选。"""
    prelude = record_prelude(document)
    header = RECORD_HEADER.search(prelude)
    if header:
        metadata = json.loads(header[1])
    else:
        if f"会话 `{scope.session}`" not in prelude:
            return document
        metadata = record_metadata(scope, path.parents[2], "沿用已有主记录")
    if "titleCandidate" in metadata:
        return document
    metadata["titleCandidate"] = candidate
    # 转义可能提前结束 Markdown 注释的字符，保留读回的标题原值。
    encoded = json.dumps(metadata, ensure_ascii=False).replace(">", r"\u003e")
    if header:
        return document[:header.start(1)] + encoded + document[header.end(1):]
    return f"<!-- foundry-recording {encoded} -->\n\n{document}"


def find_record(scope):
    """优先复用经来源核实的记录，绕开新命中的 Git 忽略位置。"""
    suffix = Path("records") / scope.opening / f"{scope.session}.md"
    roots = list(candidate_roots(scope.project))
    files = git(scope.project, "ls-files", "-z", "--cached", "--others", "--exclude-standard",
                "--", f":(glob)**/{suffix.as_posix()}")
    ignored = git(scope.project, "ls-files", "-z", "--ignored", "--others", "--exclude-standard",
                  "--", f":(glob)**/{suffix.as_posix()}")
    known = {base / suffix for base, _ in roots}
    known.update(scope.project / os.fsdecode(path) for path in (files.stdout + ignored.stdout).split(b"\0") if path)
    existing = []
    superseded = set()
    for path in sorted(known):
        if not inside_project(scope.project, path) or not path.is_file():
            continue
        content = path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
        marker = RECORD_HEADER.search(record_prelude(content))
        if not marker:
            # 保留并复用具备相同会话头的旧版记录。
            if f"会话 `{scope.session}`" not in content:
                raise ValueError(f"主记录同名文件归属不明：{path}")
        else:
            saved = json.loads(marker[1])
            if (saved.get("session"), saved.get("project"), saved.get("origin")) != (
                scope.session, str(scope.project), str(scope.origin)
            ):
                raise ValueError(f"主记录会话来源不符：{path}")
            superseded.update(scope.project / item for item in saved.get("previousRecords", []) if isinstance(item, str))
        existing.append((path, content))
    eligible = [(path, content) for path, content in existing if path not in superseded and visible(scope.project, path)]
    if len(eligible) > 1:
        raise ValueError("存在多份可写的同一会话主记录")
    if eligible:
        return eligible[0]
    for base, reason in roots:
        path = base / suffix
        if not path.exists() and visible(scope.project, path):
            details = record_metadata(scope, base, reason)
            if existing:
                details["previousRecords"] = [str(path.relative_to(scope.project)) for path, _ in existing]
                details["restartTurn"] = scope.turn
            heading = (f"# 对话记录\n\n会话 `{scope.session}` · 开启 `{scope.opened_at}` · 目录 `{scope.origin}`\n\n"
                       f"<!-- foundry-recording {json.dumps(details, ensure_ascii=False)} -->\n")
            return path, heading
    raise OSError("找不到 Git 可见的项目内记录位置")


def quoted(label, value):
def detail_document(scope, path, events):
    """逐项确认附件与详情，再把可用的链接交给主记录。"""
    target = path.parent / "details" / scope.session / f"{scope.turn}.md"
    if not visible(scope.project, target):
        raise OSError(f"详情路径不在可写的 Git 范围：{target}")
    owner = f"<!-- foundry-detail {scope.session} {scope.turn} -->"
    header = f"# 对话经过\n\n会话 `{scope.session}` · 轮次 `{scope.turn}`\n\n{owner}\n"
    previous = target.read_bytes().decode("utf-8") if target.is_file() else header
    if not previous.startswith(header):
        raise OSError(f"同名详情归属未确认：{target}")
    prelude, blocks = detail_blocks(previous)
    for event in events:
        key = sha256((event.identity or f"{event.location}:{event.label}").encode()).hexdigest()
        if key in blocks and blocks[key][0]:
            continue
        length = max((len(match[0]) for match in re.finditer(r"~+", event.value)), default=0)
        fence = "~" * max(3, length + 1)
        pieces = [f"## {event.label}\n\n- 来源定位：{event.location}\n\n{fence}text\n{event.value}\n{fence}\n"]
        complete = not event.provisional
        for attachment in event.attachments:
            checksum = sha256(attachment.data).hexdigest()
            name = Path(redacted(attachment.name))
            filename = f"{name.stem}-{checksum}{name.suffix}"
            text = attachment.data.decode("utf-8", errors="surrogateescape")
            if redacted(text) != text:
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：原件包含需省略的内容。\n")
                continue
            original = target.parent / "attachments" / filename
            if not visible(scope.project, original):
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：原件目标不在 Git 可见范围。\n")
                complete = False
                continue
            if original.is_file() and original.read_bytes() != attachment.data:
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：同一摘要路径已有不同内容。\n")
                complete = False
                continue
            try:
                atomic_write(original, attachment.data)
            except OSError:
                pieces.append("\n- 附件缺口：原件写入或读回失败。\n")
                complete = False
                continue
            pieces.append(f"\n- [附件](attachments/{quote(filename)}) · SHA-256 `{checksum}`\n")
        status = "event" if complete else "pending"
        blocks[key] = (complete, f"<!-- foundry-{status} {key} -->\n" + "".join(pieces) + "\n")
    atomic_write(target, prelude + "".join(block for _, block in blocks.values()))
    return target.relative_to(path.parent).as_posix()


@dataclass
class TurnRecord:
def write_timeline(scope, path, document, agent_messages=()):
    """在父会话锁内按事件身份合并子代理消息并保存。"""
    if agent_messages:
        turns, messages, _ = record_sections(document)
        if turns and turns[-1][2][1]:
            document = modernize_last_turn(path, document, turns)
            turns, messages, _ = record_sections(document)
        if not messages or messages[-1].start < turns[-1][0]:
            raise ValueError("主记录缺少可续写子代理消息的轮次")
        known = {message.agent.identity for message in messages if message.agent}
        blocks = []
        for note, value in agent_messages:
            if note.identity not in known:
                blocks.append(MESSAGE_SEPARATOR + agent_block(note, value))
                known.add(note.identity)
        end = messages[-1].end
        document = document[:end] + "".join(blocks) + document[end:]
    if "foundry-agent-message" in document:
        turns, messages, _ = record_sections(document)
        document = order_timeline(scope.transcript, document, turns, messages)
    atomic_write(path, document)
    return document


def modernize_last_turn(path, document, turns):
            links.append((match.start() - 1, link[1]))
    return turns, messages, links


def open_turn(scope):
    """找到本轮，保留旧格式及其他轮次的原始字节。"""
    path, current = find_record(scope)
    turns, messages, links = record_sections(current)
    index = next((i for i, (_, _, heading) in enumerate(turns) if heading[3] == scope.turn), None)
    if index is None:
        separator = MESSAGE_SEPARATOR if turns else "\n"
        return TurnRecord(path, current + separator, f"## {scope.date} <!-- turn-{scope.turn} -->\n", "", [])

    _, start, heading = turns[index]
    end = turns[index + 1][0] if index + 1 < len(turns) else len(current)
    text = current[start:end]
    after = current[end:]
    if heading[1]:
        separator = "\n" if text.endswith("\n\n") else ""
        saved = [(label, value.replace("\n>   ", "\n")) for label, value in LEGACY_MESSAGE.findall(text)]
        return TurnRecord(path, current[:start], text.removesuffix(separator), separator + after, saved, legacy=True)

    saved = [(item.label, item.text) for item in messages if start <= item.start < end and item.agent is None]
    footer = next(((position, link) for position, link in links if start <= position < end), None)
    if footer:
        position, detail = footer
        return TurnRecord(path, current[:start], current[start:position], after, saved, detail=detail)
    return TurnRecord(path, current[:start], text, after, saved)


def load_turn(scope, inputs):
    """按宿主确认过的输入补齐缺失消息。"""
    turn = open_turn(scope)
    if not turn.messages:
        if not inputs:
            return None
        turn.append("发起", inputs[0])
    existing = sum(label == "补充" for label, _ in turn.messages)
    for supplemental in inputs[1 + existing:]:
        turn.append("补充", supplemental)
    return turn


def link_details(scope, turn, events):
    """确认详情后补上链接，返回可在主记录保存后报告的写入错误。"""
    if not events:
        return None
    try:
        link = detail_document(scope, turn.path, events)
    except OSError as error:
        return error
    if not turn.legacy:
        turn.detail = link
    elif "\n> - [查看经过](" not in turn.text:
        turn.text += f"> - [查看经过]({link})\n"
    return None


@contextmanager
def session_lock(scope):
    """串行化同一会话的记录更新。"""
    with scope.transcript.open("rb") as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        yield


def run_hook(event_name, handle, *, cwd=None):
    """接收指定的 Codex 事件，核验归属并报告记录缺口。"""
    data = json.load(sys.stdin)
    if data.get("hook_event_name") != event_name:
        return
    # 共享模块安装在 <项目根>/.agents/skills/conversation-recording/recording/。
    project = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[4]
    try:
        scope = verify_scope(project, data, Path(data["cwd"]) if cwd is None else cwd,
                             allow_idle=event_name == "SubagentStop")
        if scope is not None:
            handle(scope, data)
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, OSError, sqlite3.Error) as error:
        # 记录故障保留为提示，业务轮次继续。
        message = redacted(f"会话记录出现缺口 · {data.get('turn_id')} · {data.get('hook_event_name')}：{error}")
        print(json.dumps({"systemMessage": message}, ensure_ascii=False))

from pathlib import Path
import shlex
import sqlite3
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from uuid import uuid4


SOURCE = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "src/profile/conversation-recording"


class ConversationRecordingTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="foundry-recording-test-")
        self.addCleanup(temporary.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(temporary.name)
        self.repo = self.root / "repo"
        self.repo.mkdir()
        subprocess.run(["git", "init", "-q", str(self.repo)], check=True)
        self.hooks = self.repo / ".codex/hooks.json"
        self.hooks.parent.mkdir()
        self.other_hook = {"hooks": [{"type": "command", "command": "other-project-hook"}]}
        self.hooks.write_text(json.dumps({"hooks": {"Stop": [self.other_hook]}}))
        self.state = self.root / "state"
        self.turn, self.session = str(uuid4()), str(uuid4())
        self.transcript = self.state / f"sessions/2026/11/25/rollout-2026-11-25T20-00-00-{self.session}.jsonl"
        self.transcript.parent.mkdir(parents=True)
        self.env = {**os.environ, "CODEX_HOME": str(self.state), "CODEX_SQLITE_HOME": str(self.state)}
        self.record = self.repo / f"records/2026-11-25/{self.session}.md"

    def install(self, check=True):
        return subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-B", str(SOURCE / "install.py"), "--project", str(self.repo)],
                              text=True, capture_output=True, check=check, env=self.env)

    def seed_turn(self, trigger="user", events=(), origin=None):
        header = {"type": "session_meta", "payload": {"id": self.session, "cwd": str(origin or self.repo),
                  "timestamp": "2026-11-25T12:00:00Z", "originator": "codex-tui", "source": "vscode"}}
        started = {"type": "event_msg", "ordinal": 1, "timestamp": "2026-11-26T12:00:00Z", "payload": {
            "type": "task_started", "turn_id": self.turn, "turn_attribution": {"turn_trigger": trigger}}}
        first = (json.dumps(header) + "\n").encode()
        self.transcript.write_bytes(first + "".join(json.dumps(event) + "\n" for event in [started, *events]).encode())
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "thread_history_1.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS thread_turns (thread_id, turn_id, status, rollout_byte_offset)")
            index.execute("DELETE FROM thread_turns")
            index.execute("INSERT INTO thread_turns VALUES (?, ?, 'inProgress', ?)", (self.session, self.turn, len(first)))

    def callback(self, event, **values):
        hooks = json.loads(self.hooks.read_text())["hooks"]
        self.assertIn(event, hooks, f"安装应登记 {event}")
        groups = hooks[event]
        cmd = groups[-1]["hooks"][0]["command"]
        data = {"hook_event_name": event, "session_id": self.session, "turn_id": self.turn,
                "cwd": str(self.repo), "transcript_path": str(self.transcript), **values}
        result = subprocess.run(["bash", "-c", cmd], input=json.dumps(data), cwd=self.repo, env=self.env,
                                text=True, capture_output=True)
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stderr)
        return json.loads(result.stdout or "{}")

    def test_installer_preserves_other_hooks_and_is_idempotent(self):
        installed = self.install(check=False)
        self.assertEqual(installed.returncode, 0, installed.stderr)
        initial = self.hooks.read_bytes()
        hooks = json.loads(initial)["hooks"]
        self.assertEqual(hooks["Stop"][0], self.other_hook)
        self.assertEqual(len(hooks["UserPromptSubmit"]), 1)
        self.assertEqual(len(hooks["Stop"]), 2)
        skill = self.repo / ".agents/skills/conversation-recording"
        self.assertTrue((skill / "SKILL.md").is_file())
        self.assertEqual({file.name for file in (skill / "scripts").iterdir()},
                         {"user_prompt_submit.py", "post_tool_use.py", "stop.py", "subagent_stop.py"})
        for event, script in (("UserPromptSubmit", "user_prompt_submit.py"),
                              ("PostToolUse", "post_tool_use.py"), ("Stop", "stop.py"),
                              ("SubagentStop", "subagent_stop.py")):
            command = shlex.split(hooks[event][-1]["hooks"][0]["command"])
            self.assertEqual(Path(command[3]), skill / "scripts" / script)
            self.assertTrue(Path(command[3]).is_file())
        self.install()
        self.assertEqual(self.hooks.read_bytes(), initial)

    def append_host_events(self, transcript, *events):
        with transcript.open("a", encoding="utf-8") as output:
            for event in events:
                output.write(json.dumps(event, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")

    def parent_status(self, status):
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "thread_history_1.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("UPDATE thread_turns SET status = ? WHERE thread_id = ? AND turn_id = ?",
                          (status, self.session, self.turn))

    def next_parent_turn(self, timestamp):
        self.parent_status("completed")
        self.turn = str(uuid4())
        offset = self.transcript.stat().st_size
        self.append_host_events(self.transcript, {
            "type": "event_msg", "timestamp": timestamp, "payload": {
                "type": "task_started", "turn_id": self.turn, "turn_attribution": {"turn_trigger": "user"}}},
            {"type": "turn_context", "payload": {"turn_id": self.turn, "cwd": str(self.repo)}})
        with closing(sqlite3.connect(self.state / "thread_history_1.sqlite")) as index, index:
            index.execute("INSERT INTO thread_turns VALUES (?, ?, 'inProgress', ?)",
                          (self.session, self.turn, offset))

    @staticmethod
    def final_answer(timestamp, text):
        return {"type": "response_item", "timestamp": timestamp, "payload": {
            "type": "message", "role": "assistant", "phase": "final_answer",
            "content": [{"type": "output_text", "text": text}]}}

    def test_title_candidate_has_verified_origin_and_is_saved_once(self):
        self.install()
        self.seed_turn()
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="排查会话记录")
        child = str(uuid4())
        self.launch_child("name-task", child, "宿主提供的派发正文", "2026-11-26T12:00:01Z", task_name="recording_title")
        self.callback("Stop", last_assistant_message="主回复已经发送")
        self.parent_status("completed")
        at = "2026-11-26T12:00:03Z"
        reply = self.child_reply(child, self.turn, '{"title":"排查会话记录"}', at, agent_path="/root/recording_title")
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.title_candidate(), {
            "title": "排查会话记录", "parentTurn": self.turn, "dispatchCall": "name-task",
            "childThread": child, "childTurn": reply["turn_id"], "repliedAt": at,
        })
        saved = self.record.read_bytes()
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.record.read_bytes(), saved)
        self.next_parent_turn("2026-11-26T12:00:04Z")
        self.callback("UserPromptSubmit", prompt="继续核对")
        newer = str(uuid4())
        self.launch_child("later-name", newer, "再次尝试命名", "2026-11-26T12:00:05Z", task_name="recording_title")
        self.parent_status("completed")
        new_reply = self.child_reply(newer, self.turn, '{"title":"另一标题"}', "2026-11-26T12:00:06Z",
                                     agent_path="/root/recording_title")
        self.assertEqual(self.callback("SubagentStop", **new_reply), {})
        self.assertEqual(self.title_candidate()["title"], "排查会话记录")

    def test_title_candidate_empty_result_can_be_followed_by_a_valid_attempt(self):
